title: Mascot Track
style: A mascot-led metaphor: a soft, rounded robot mascot (two stacked rounded bodies, a visor, a tiny antenna) is a race car without a track. We build its track from concept blocks, then watch it race a top-down road, flicking finished-task chips off to the sides. Soft shadows, rounded forms, a subtle floor. Captions are serif word ladders (kit captions.ts): short stacks of mixed sizes, one key word in the accent italic, set beside the action and arriving word by word.
learnsFrom: Founder explainer reels (Instagram, @gregisenberg's team): a soft robot mascot, a metaphor that carries the whole piece (F1 cars need a track), concept blocks stacking into a foundation, a top-down road with task chips flying off.

story.what: hook: the mascot bounces in and revs; caption 'Your assistant is a race car.'
it lurches forward and stalls in a flat empty desert; caption 'with no track'
four blocks drop and stack into a foundation under it: 'Calendars', 'Preferences', 'Rules', 'History'; caption 'Give it a track.'
top-down: a road draws itself toward us; the mascot races down it; chips ('invite sent', 'room booked', 'agenda', 'reminder') flick off both sides
a person figure appears at a checkpoint; the mascot stops, the person taps 'Yes' on one card; caption 'you keep the decisions that matter'
sign-off: mascot waves beside 'Oriel'; caption 'find a time that works for everyone'

sizes: Square frames the mascot larger with captions above; the road scene becomes a tighter crop.
sound: beatScore soft at 120 bpm with a rev (a rising tone) at the start, thumps as blocks land, whooshes as chips fly off, and the sign-off.
teaches: A mascot plus one metaphor carries a whole explainer: every beat is the metaphor doing something new.
